title: English Practice Quiz 0963
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A weather forecast predicts ___.
options: the exact result of every election
questions.explanation: A forecast gives an estimate of future weather.

questions.question: During a thunderstorm, it is safer to stay ___.
questions.explanation: A substantial enclosed building offers better protection from lightning.

questions.question: A flood warning means people should ___.
options: follow official safety instructions and avoid floodwater
questions.explanation: Official instructions help people respond to flood risk.

questions.question: A drought is a long period with ___.
questions.explanation: Drought involves an extended shortage of precipitation.

questions.question: During an emergency, information should come from ___.
questions.explanation: Official sources are more dependable for emergency instructions.

questions.question: An evacuation is the act of ___.
questions.explanation: Evacuation moves people from a hazardous area to safety.

questions.question: A first-aid kit should be kept ___.
options: locked away with no authorised access
questions.explanation: A checked and accessible kit can be useful in an emergency.

questions.question: If heavy rain reduces visibility while driving, you should ___.
options: slow down and increase following distance
switch off the headlights at night
follow the vehicle ahead very closely
questions.explanation: Lower speed and more distance allow extra time to react.

questions.question: A heatwave is a period of ___.
questions.explanation: A heatwave is an extended spell of unusually high temperatures.

questions.question: An emergency contact list should contain ___.
options: current numbers for relevant responders and responsible staff
questions.explanation: Accurate contact details help people reach the right support quickly.
